title: Certify the minimum 237-row P112 demand subfamily (no κ)
body:
For the fixed 14-variable/280-row P112 demand matrix in [Nick Petalas’s PR6425](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6425), exact nonnegative combinations remove 43 rows. The retained **237 rows are the unique minimum equivalent subfamily of those original280 inequalities**, over nonnegative real multiplicities with `x>=0` fixed.

Each deletion has a rational coefficient/RHS certificate using only final-retained rows. Each retained row has a full14-coordinate rational point satisfying all279 other original rows and strictly violating that row. These two certificate forms establish equivalence and force every equivalent original-row subfamily to contain all237. The proof does not trust simplex status or floating tolerances.

A concrete example: target `0x1d1a`, demand3, follows from half each of retained `0x1412`, `0x1818` and `0xd0a`, all demand2. The weighted coefficients fit inside the target; nonnegativity supplies the remaining half-coordinate slack.

Only `research/p112-farkas-kernel/` is added. [PROOF.md](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7fdae743973bebb77daf4508d05655dc1e8915c7/research/p112-farkas-kernel/PROOF.md), [RESULT.json](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7fdae743973bebb77daf4508d05655dc1e8915c7/research/p112-farkas-kernel/RESULT.json) and [TASK.json / next questions](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7fdae743973bebb77daf4508d05655dc1e8915c7/research/p112-farkas-kernel/TASK.json) delimit the scope. This takes PR6425’s first Open next question. `complex-rank-shape-decoder` has `scope_status=changed`: a finite support-screen implication replaces the broader full-supplier task. No coefficient synthesis, COPY floor, physical supplier, κ or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Validation (CPython3.12, standard library only):
```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/p112-farkas-kernel/verify.py
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/p112-farkas-kernel/oracle.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-farkas-kernel
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p112-farkas-kernel --check-source-history --check-modes
```
Normal/`-O` emissions and strict defaults pass, with identical full receipts. The exact bounded generator uses2272 pivots, maximum49 per target. A separately implemented checker consumes the sealed certificate as untrusted data, without importing the generator or solving an LP; all43 implications,237×279 full-original-row comparisons and14 corruption/schema controls pass. This is independent certificate checking, not blind rediscovery. The registered replay, committed bytes/modes/declared-base history, official export and read-only Git-free/empty-PATH normal/`-O` replays pass; cold bytes and modes remain unchanged. Static AI review found no material issue in the stated domain.

Exact source: PR6425 head `092dcbd13d1263e691ad29f34fbf286fea1fac2c`; inert source RESULT Git blob `e18f92e001b8ce9d44287760516bf6ea002bcbcd`, SHA256 `f8d15306112914af299acca8720779fbc9f6f07bb1336c51e99304fdea5caf89`. Both source files are authenticated before parsing; no predecessor executable or clique census is replayed. Primary receipt SHA256 `b477f2a8d144ed884c78ee29ac76fd88c95b076eb2dd290ef2431dd7e4969704`; independent receipt `02c89eed3237e401b4b16563529de77cba8925439f2e67c86021a27846fccc81`. Public tree `b842829a950addc20da16bbac83b32b2aa036608` equals the tested/exported tree.

The source262928-clique equivalence is a credited PR6425 premise when composing with the larger geometry, not new independent census coverage. The minimum excludes arbitrary replacement inequalities and integer-only minima;134 displayed separators are integral, which does not settle the integer-only screen. Changed caps require a rebuilt quotient. Actual coefficients, access/restoration, precision/tape, stock, compiler, native and outer integration remain open; all five selected assumptions remain. Selected/native/Lean/Docker replays were not run.

Canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, revision8, selected6030 unchanged. Main/guidance/source and live overlap were refreshed before submission:405open PR bodies plus a latest30 refresh, bounded all-state queries, visible claims and pinned ledger. Sparse notes, hidden/unpublished work and arbitrary history remain coverage limits. PR6430 uses another P112 screen; PR6424 another B2 model. PR5767 verifies supplied LP certificates and supplies no optimizer; its shared128-variable cap/code are unchanged.

Credit Nick Petalas/PR6425; Jeremy Diviney/PR1422 for the guard, geometry/caps and smaller-family question; Cinna Davis/PR1347/1323; Navinor, David Arias, Hanson Sun, DreamingOfClouds, themilkman216 and retained E8/label/decoder lineage. LP duality, simplex/Bland and nonnegative implication are classical. New work is ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. AI corroboration is not human or formal proof-kernel acceptance.
